module: Manages the rally editor's "ghost notebook": a second notebook (or the active notebook's calibration metadata) whose notes are displayed as text in the 3D view, for comparison with the notebook being edited. The module returns a constructor (class C). It lists the notebooks available in the mission folder, loads one, and computes a short label per pacenote (legacy English text, composer output, structured elements, or name). Rendering is done by ghostRenderer.
usage:
local ghost = require('/lua/ge/extensions/editor/rallyEditor/ghostNotebook')(rallyEditor)
for _, c in ipairs(ghost:listChoices()) do print(c.label) end
if ghost:select('<metadata>') then print(ghost:getSelectedLabel()) end
notes: Special choice '<metadata>': the ghost is then the pacenotes window's active notebook, and the label comes from pacenote.metadata.calibration (descriptor/intensity, direction, length, shape).
Priority order of a pacenote's label: custom audio, legacy English text (notes.english), structured composer output, structured elements, then pacenote.name.
Calls to the composer are protected by pcall: an error simply gives an empty or nil label.
Labels are cached at select() in self.labels (keyed by pacenote.id); in '<metadata>' mode they are recomputed on every call.

C.desc: Object returned by the module constructor (new(rallyEditor)). Fields: rallyEditor, selectedFname, path (loaded notebook), labels (table id -> label), error (message or nil).

init.desc: Internal constructor: stores the editor and resets the state.

rallyEditor.desc: Rally editor instance (uses getCurrentMissionDir and getPacenotesWindow).

clear.desc: Forgets the selected ghost notebook, its path, labels and error.

clearState.desc: Alias of clear(), called by the editor on a state reset.

listChoices.desc: Lists the selectable ghosts: first the '<metadata>' entry, then each notebook in the mission folder. Returns an empty table if there is no current mission.

returns.type: table<integer, {fname: string, basename: string, label: string}>
returns.desc: Each entry gives the full path, the base name and the display label (without .notebook.json).

activeNotebook.desc: Returns the notebook currently being edited (path field of the pacenotes window), or nil.

select.desc: Loads the indicated ghost notebook ('<metadata>' = active notebook), refreshes its structured notes and precomputes the labels. An empty or nil name clears the selection. On failure, fills self.error and logs an error.

fname.desc: Full path of the notebook, or '<metadata>'.

returns.desc: true if the selection succeeded (or was cleared), false if the notebook could not be loaded.

getSelectedLabel.desc: Returns the display label of the selected ghost, or '(none)' if nothing is selected.

getError.desc: Returns the last load error message.

getLabelForPacenote.desc: Returns the text to display for a ghost pacenote. In '<metadata>' mode, builds the label from the calibration metadata (empty string if absent); otherwise uses the cache then recomputes.

returns.desc: Label, or nil if pacenote is nil.
